summary.zh-CN: 胸痛患者的心电图存在传导异常，比较连续记录并决定处理紧迫性。
summary.en: Chest pain with a conduction abnormality requires comparison of serial recordings and a decision about urgency.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别 RBBB 背景下的动态缺血信号。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise evolving ischaemic signs despite RBBB.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 整合胸痛与标志物确定处理紧迫性。
learningOutcomes.en: Integrate pain and biomarkers to determine urgency.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 避免把不典型 ST 形态作为排除依据。
learningOutcomes.en: Avoid excluding occlusion on atypical ST morphology.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明基线缺失限制新发 RBBB 判断。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why absent baseline ECG limits classification as new RBBB.

text.zh-CN: 右束支传导阻滞，V2–V3 非弓背向上 ST 抬高、T 波正向，V4–V6 为 Rs。
text.en: RBBB, non-convex ST elevation and upright T waves in V2–V3, with Rs complexes in V4–V6.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 2 小时后 V1–V3 ST 抬高、V2 T 波转负，后续 V4 呈 QS，V2–V3 与 V5–V6 的 R 波降低；症状加重时缺血和坏死图形继续演变。
text.en: After two hours, V1–V3 showed ST elevation and V2 T-wave inversion; later V4 became QS and R waves fell in V2–V3/V5–V6, with further evolution during worsening symptoms.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: cTnT 与 CK-MB 明显升高，原文未列具体数值。
text.en: cTnT and CK-MB were markedly elevated; numerical values are not supplied.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 前降支近段中重度狭窄，回旋支中段轻中度狭窄。
text.en: Moderate-to-severe proximal LAD and mild-to-moderate mid-LCx stenosis.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 症状反复后急诊造影显示前降支近段次全闭塞并置入支架；术后 1 周心电图仍为 RBBB，V2–V4 QS、V5 rS，原文称广泛梗死图形。远期结局未载。
text.en: Emergency angiography after recurrent symptoms showed subtotal proximal LAD occlusion, treated with a stent. At one week the ECG retained RBBB, QS in V2–V4 and rS in V5, described as extensive infarction changes. Long-term outcome is absent.

text.zh-CN: 高度怀疑持续心肌缺血，RBBB 不构成放心等待的依据
text.en: Strong suspicion of ongoing ischaemia; RBBB does not justify reassurance

feedback.zh-CN: 症状、动态 ST-T/R 波改变与标志物一致。
feedback.en: Symptoms, evolving ST-T/R-wave changes and biomarkers are concordant.

text.zh-CN: 全部归因于无害的继发复极改变
text.en: Attribute everything to harmless secondary repolarisation

feedback.zh-CN: 动态演变与进行性症状不能这样解释。
feedback.en: Progression and dynamic changes are not safely explained that way.

text.zh-CN: 因为没有典型弓背抬高而排除心梗
text.en: Exclude infarction without classical convex elevation

feedback.zh-CN: 形态不典型并不排除急性冠脉闭塞。
feedback.en: Atypical morphology does not exclude acute coronary occlusion.

prompt.zh-CN: 持续胸痛时应选择什么路径？
prompt.en: What pathway fits ongoing chest pain?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 立即升级心脏团队评估急诊再灌注
text.en: Urgently escalate for cardiology assessment of immediate reperfusion

feedback.zh-CN: ESC 2023 将高度疑似持续缺血伴束支阻滞作为紧急处理情境。
feedback.en: ESC 2023 treats strongly suspected ongoing ischaemia with bundle branch block as an urgent presentation.

text.zh-CN: 固定等待 24 小时，不考虑病情变化
text.en: Wait a fixed 24 hours regardless of deterioration

feedback.zh-CN: 固定延迟忽视进行性缺血。
feedback.en: A fixed delay ignores progressive ischaemia.

text.zh-CN: 先完成非急诊检查再联系介入团队
text.en: Complete non-urgent tests before contacting the interventional team

feedback.zh-CN: 不应让非必要检查延误急诊评估。
feedback.en: Non-essential tests should not delay urgent assessment.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪些结论必须保留不确定性？

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: RBBB 是否新发及确切梗死范围尚不能由现有资料确定
text.en: Whether RBBB was new and the exact infarct extent remain uncertain

feedback.zh-CN: 原文缺乏基线心电图和定量梗死范围。
feedback.en: Baseline ECG and quantified infarct extent are absent.

text.zh-CN: 既然 RBBB 就一定新发
text.en: RBBB is necessarily new

text.zh-CN: 推迟处理已经被证明造成全部损伤
text.en: Delay is proven to have caused all injury

feedback.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能量化反事实损伤。
feedback.en: A retrospective case cannot quantify counterfactual injury.

text.en: Clarify onset

text.en: Clarify progression

text.en: Review key records before deciding

text.zh-CN: 选择证据最支持的解释
text.en: Choose the interpretation best supported by the evidence

text.zh-CN: 不因束支阻滞或非典型 ST 形态延误紧急缺血评估
text.en: Do not delay urgent ischaemia assessment because of bundle branch block or atypical ST shape

text.zh-CN: 核对原报告结局并保留未知
text.en: Review the reported outcome without filling gaps

text.zh-CN: 首次选择符合证据的处理路径
text.en: Choose an evidence-consistent plan on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 解释证据与不确定性，核对患者或陪同者理解
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty and check patient or companion understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 持续缺血伴 RBBB 和动态心电图改变，后续证实前降支近段严重闭塞。
conclusion.en: Ongoing ischaemia with RBBB and evolving ECG changes preceded confirmation of severe proximal LAD obstruction.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 连续心电图应与症状变化一起解释。
keyReasoning.en: Interpret serial ECGs with symptom evolution.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 高度疑似持续缺血合并 RBBB 需紧急评估（ESC 2023）。
keyReasoning.en: Strongly suspected ongoing ischaemia with RBBB needs urgent assessment (ESC 2023).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 单例不能证明延迟与全部损伤的定量因果。
keyReasoning.en: One case cannot quantify how much injury was caused by delay.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
